name: waybill
description: A Dispatcharr plugin for managing channel configurations using Waybill manifests
author: @Matthew-Beckett

fields.label: Waybill Channel Manifest YAML
fields.description: Ignored when Manifest URL is set.

fields.label: Manifest URL
fields.description: Optional. Plan and Apply download the manifest from here on every run and ignore the YAML above; if the download fails, nothing is changed. GitHub file links are converted to their raw link. raw.githubusercontent.com can serve the previous version for about 5 minutes after a push; put a commit SHA instead of the branch name to pin a version.

fields.label: Manifest URL token
fields.description: Optional. Sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" to download from a private repository (e.g. a GitHub fine-grained token with read access to its contents).

fields.label: Auto-apply every (minutes)
fields.description: Run Apply on a timer, so epgSchedule rules follow the guide. 0 turns it off.

actions.label: Plan Manifest
actions.description: Preview the desired channel state without making any changes

actions.label: Apply Manifest
actions.description: Apply the provided manifest to Dispatcharr
